axes.label: Friendly Bleed, Curse, or Disease removal

notes: Cauterizing Flame removes Regurgitate's Disease but not Magic Paralyzing Shots; Overawe removes Ravenous Claws' Enrage.
Ebon Might and Prescience amplify allies; Blistering Scales is defensive armor support and is not counted as party damage reduction.
The source fragment naming Muro'jin, Nekraxx, Flanking Spear, Infected Pinions, and Blood Frenzy belongs to Maisara Caverns; WHELP rejects it as Blinding Vale evidence.
Zephyr applies only to area damage and the five nearest party members.
Cauterizing Flame provides the sourced Curse answer; no current Enrage target is modeled.
Quell remains the true school lockout while Tail Swipe, Wing Buffet, and Sleep Walk are susceptibility-dependent stops.
Expunge removes Heartstop Poison, Cauterizing Flame removes Curse of Doom, and Overawe can recover a missed Fel Rage interrupt by removing its Enrage.
The guide's Spectral Axethrower and Phantasmal Mystic examples belong to Windrunner Spire and are rejected as Murder Row evidence.
Quell interrupts Violent Sand, Expunge removes Corrosive Essence, and Overawe removes Bolster; these are canonical Voidscar mechanics.
Vile Lasher, Territorial Eagle, Alpha Eagle, and Algeth'ar Echoknight belong to Algeth'ar Academy and are rejected as Voidscar evidence.
Expunge handles Poison effects, Quell covers priority casts, and crowd control breaks susceptible channels or A Knot of Snakes.
Unrelated mechanics misplaced in the guide section are excluded from WHELP.
Quell priority casts and use Expunge or Cauterizing Flame only for matching player-debuff domains.
Do not Soothe Ancestral Fury despite its Enrage flag because removing the linked vulnerability can reduce group damage. Sleep Walk is limited against Undead.
The current guide section contains unrelated-instance mechanics, so no unsupported cleanse or Soothe target is recorded.
Augmentation's offensive and tank-support tools remain useful but do not answer encounter mechanics by themselves.

recommendations: Tail Swipe and Wing Buffet handle clustered orbs; Quell covers a separated cast. These stops retain distinct semantics.
Keep Ebon Might and priority damage focused on the emissary; no utility shortcut is sourced.
Time Spiral, Spatial Paradox, or Rescue support partner movement; the choice-node tools cannot be selected together.
Cauterizing Flame removes an eligible non-Magic shield and Rescue supports positioning without being classified as a dispel.

provenance.description: Original structured summary of Jereico's Patch 12.1.0 Augmentation dungeon and affix guidance, cross-checked against canonical spell and dungeon records.
